claims: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq are closed on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq will reopen on Monday, April 6, at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time.
Bond markets will close early at 12 p.m. ET on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
Banks remain open on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
The USPS remains open on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
London Stock Exchange is closed on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
Euronext Paris is closed on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
Shanghai maintains normal hours on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
Tokyo maintains normal hours on Good Friday (April 3, 2026).
The next market holiday after Good Friday (April 3, 2026) is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
